_comment: Root landing page. It is an index, not a dashboard: no figures are quoted here, so it substitutes nothing and reads no facts file. Each project's own README carries its numbers, next to the evidence for them.
_hero_comment: No badges: the shields.io row right under the hero already covers Power BI/PBIR/TMDL/Python+PowerShell/MIT - baking them into the SVG a second time said nothing new.

hero.name: hero
hero.title: Power BI, as source code
hero.subtitle: Two dashboards that answer a real question, two tools that kill a hundred clicks — and every artefact kept as text you can diff.

banners.name: section-observability
banners.title: BigQuery + dbt Cost Observability
banners.body: Where the warehouse spend went, and which dbt model, test or hook spent it. Ships a synthetic month, so it refreshes with no cloud account.

banners.name: section-netflix
banners.title: What's On Netflix
banners.body: One Kaggle CSV of everything Netflix listed up to September 2021, turned into a model that answers what the catalogue is made of, where it comes from, and when it arrived.

banners.name: section-remap
banners.title: PBIR Field Remap Toolkit
banners.body: Repoint every field reference in a report from one table or column to another, driven by a CSV. Inventory first, then one command, no flags to get wrong.

banners.name: section-descriptions
banners.title: Semantic Model Descriptions
banners.body: Load field descriptions into a TMDL model from a CSV, as the /// comments that surface as tooltips in Power BI Desktop.
